learnings.title: GitHub changelog: Issue types and issue fields are generally available for personal-account repositories
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-11-issue-types-and-fields-are-available-for-personal-accounts (feed pubDate Wed, 11 Nov 2026 17:16:46 +0000; dated November 11, 2026; read 2026-11-13) states issue types and issue fields are now generally available on repositories owned by personal accounts, bringing the same planning capabilities to individual developers and open source maintainers. Defaults: issue types Bug, Task, Feature (up to 25 custom types); issue fields Priority, Effort, Start date, Target date (up to 25 fields; text, number, date, single-select, multi-select). Configured from personal account settings under Planning; fields can be pinned to types or used on untyped issues; usable in projects for views and bulk updates; manageable via REST and GraphQL APIs and webhooks. The same entry adds creating labels and milestones directly from an issue.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: relevant only if system workflows triage issues in personal-account repos (e.g. cerniva/*) or want issue types/fields via API; no code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-20 whether any system workflow needs issue types/fields in cerniva repositories.
